content:
Ethan Cole: Hey all, first-day hiccup. Okta shows my account as ethan@redwood.com but I also see ethan.c.personal@gmail.com listed under alternate emails. I got a 1Password invite to the personal address. Also when I try to register a passkey on my Mac it keeps offering Windows Hello. Anyone seen the personal-email + passkey combo?
Mira (People Ops): Welcome Ethan! :wave: Sorry about that. DM me the personal email and I'll remove it from your profile and resend invites to your work email.
Ethan Cole: DM sent. Thanks.
IT Support: Creating ticket ONB-7708 to track. Quick Q: did you sign into Okta using the Google SSO button or via the direct Okta URL?
Ethan Cole: Used the Okta link in the welcome mail.
Maria (IT): Two likely issues: 1) People Ops still had your personal email on file so the 1Password invite went there; 2) the passkey flow mentioning Windows Hello is a generic prompt when browser feature-detect thinks Windows APIs are available. Which browser/version are you using?
Ethan Cole: Safari 16.6 on macOS Ventura. Trying to add a security key (YubiKey 5 NFC) but enrollment failed with "device not recognized."
Maria (IT): For Safari + passkeys: use the native passkey flow in System Settings -> Passwords -> Add Passkey, or enroll via Chrome if Safari behaves oddly. For YubiKey, ensure firmware supports FIDO2 and that you try the USB-C slot (or NFC on phone). If it says not recognized, try `ykman info` on a machine with Python/yubikey-manager.
DevEx - Priya: If you want I can force reprovisioning of GSuite groups too, but sounds like this is primarily identity contact cleanup + passkey enrollment. LMK and I can run `/provisioning resync ethan.cole` from admin.
invites-bot: [ONB-7708] Ticket created and assigned to Maria (IT).
Mira (People Ops): Removed personal email and resent 1Password invite to ethan@redwood.com.
Ethan Cole: Received invite in work email. Trying passkey in System Settings now.
Ethan Cole: Enrolled passkey successfully at 1872224625. YubiKey also works in Chrome after firmware update. All good now, thanks folks!
IT Support: Marking ONB-7708 resolved. Reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
